name: Sweet!
source:
Kyoichi has no job. One day, a woman visits his house, and offers him to become a manager of a newly opened maid cafe. He accepts her offer, and begins to work at the maid cafe "Sucre"....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
恭一没有工作。一天，一名女性来到他家，邀请他担任一家新开女仆咖啡馆的店长。他接受了邀请，开始在名为“Sucre”的女仆咖啡馆工作…

[摘自ErogeShop]
